prompts.title: Victorian Elegance
prompts.prompt: Create a photorealistic luxury portrait of a young girl seated elegantly in a cream-colored tufted wingback armchair inside a sophisticated classical European-style interior. She wears an elegant ivory satin dress with puff sleeves, a large burgundy velvet bow at the waist, layered pearl necklaces, long burgundy opera gloves, delicate white lace tights, and glossy white Mary Jane shoes. Her hair is styled in a neat, intricate high bun with small pearl accessories. She sits gracefully with her legs crossed, looking slightly to the side with a gentle, innocent smile. Warm natural sunlight streams through tall windows with sheer white curtains, creating a soft, dreamy glow. Cream walls with ornate panel molding, a white fireplace mantel, elegant floral arrangements, and luxurious decor fill the background. prompts.title: Dreamy Birthday Bliss
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image as an reference for the girl’s face, hair & identity.  Do not alter facial features.
A full-body portrait of a reference cute girl standing beside a birthday cake at a themed party, centered in a soft, dreamy indoor studio setting.
The theme is fully inspired by Hello Kitty, with a color palette of soft pink, white, and red, with subtle pastel accents.
The child has a sweet smile, and hair styled in an elegant updo with soft curls framing her face.
She is wearing a luxurious, sparkling dress in white and soft pink tones, with delicate lace details, glitter textures, and Hello Kitty character patterns printed across the fabric.
The dress features a semi-transparent lace neckline and sleeves, with a flared skirt decorated with bows, hearts, and subtle shimmering particles.
She also wears a decorative headband featuring Hello Kitty ears with a signature red bow and a small elegant tiara detail.
On her feet are white lace knee-high socks and glossy red shoes with bow details.

She stands in an elegant, natural pose: her body is slightly angled (~15–20°) and not fully frontal. Her weight is shifted onto one leg, while the other leg is placed slightly forward in a gentle cross-over stance. Her posture is upright but soft with relaxed shoulders, and her head is slightly tilted toward the camera. One arm hangs relaxed by her side with a slight natural bend, while her other hand softly rests on the cake stand.
Next to her on a classic, matte white pedestal stand resting a tall, three-tier birthday cake in pink and white gradient tones, decorated with bows, hearts, stars, and multiple Hello Kitty figurines.
The cake topper shows a number “7” candle.On the front of the cake, a decorative plaque reads: “Happy Birthday” in elegant script.
The background is filled with a festive balloon arrangement in pink, white, and red, forming an arch above her.
Hanging across the backdrop is a triangular banner with Hello Kitty faces and patterns.
Warm fairy string lights glow softly behind, creating a magical bokeh effect.
Light fog or mist surrounds the lower area, adding a dreamy atmosphere.
Around the scene are multiple Hello Kitty plush toys placed on the floor and small stools, reinforcing the theme.
The floor is light wood, and the lighting is soft, warm, and diffused, enhancing the child’s face and the sparkle of her outfit.
At the floor, add a beautiful greeting card with the text: “Prompt Plum” in a decorative style.
